svg.text: one request bundle out, one response bundle back, each walked down a chain of registers by a 1-bit token
req_sr(j) advances only when fwd_tok(j-1) is set
so every stage holds its payload until the next transaction pushes through it, which is what keeps
the far end stable across a multi-cycle handshake and removes the need for a capture register at either end
gating the whole chain on the OR of all the tokens instead would clobber the last stage
on the cycle the token reached it
